findings.issue: API_BASE_URL flows through the explicit env-var API that only graduated from experimental with SvelteKit 3.0 on 2026-10-01, so a still-evolving surface is a central dependency
findings.suggestion: Keep as-is (legacy $env/* is deprecated in SK3 and removed in SK4), but keep all $app/env/private imports behind the existing single wrapper in src/lib/server/api.ts so any further churn stays a one-file fix

findings.issue: The app is built on a framework major released ~4 weeks ago (with Vite 8, TypeScript 6 and adapter-node 6 as its new minimums), so expect a stream of early 3.x patch churn
findings.suggestion: Pin via the lockfile and watch the 3.x changelog for the first weeks; have `npx sv migrate` available for any follow-up breaking adjustments

findings.issue: The filename-based runes-forcing predicate silently overrides any per-file <svelte:options runes={false}> escape hatch in first-party components
findings.suggestion: Acceptable as generated scaffolding; drop the block when Svelte 6 makes runes the only mode, as the adjacent comment already notes

summary: The app contains zero experimental, preview or canary APIs — every flag and unstable name the static analysis could look for is absent, and the one frontier feature in SvelteKit 3 (remote functions) was deliberately not used. Its bet is adopting the current stable major wholesale: the newly-stable explicit env-var system (central, but wrapped in src/env.ts with one import site) and the March-2026 function-form runes option in vite.config.ts. Net risk is low churn exposure on a weeks-old stable release, not experimental instability.
